_meta.display_only: Tendencies are DISPLAY-ONLY context for bettors. They NEVER feed fair_p, sim, seat, or any calculator weight.
_meta.source: ticket-forge ledger archive only (index.jsonl + games/<date>/<event_id>.json box scores)

rules.sample_label: n==1 SINGLE_GAME, n==2 THIN_SAMPLE, n>=3 STANDARD; n always printed
rules.home_away_split: side shown when n_side>=1; comparison only when both sides n>=2
rules.overall_band: player's most recent 10 played games, all opponents: floor=min, natural=mean, ceiling=max
rules.band_vs_opponent: NOT_COMPUTABLE unless n>=10 vs that opponent
